name: The Knight Dance
source:
Gather 'round, young and old. Listen as I regale you with the tale of two lovers; one as sure as the other is stubborn. Dancing shoes, a few stolen hours each night. And an important decision to be made. Does love truly conquer all... or is love never enough?

[From [url=https://hummingbird-games.itch.io/the-knight-dance]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
聚集在一起，年轻的和年长的。听我给你讲两个恋人的故事；一个和另一个一样固执。舞鞋，每晚偷几个小时。并做出一个重要的决定。爱真的能征服一切吗……还是爱还不够？

[来自[url=https://hummingbird-games.itch.io/the-knight-dance]Itch.io[/url]]
